issue_context.title: TiDB should take care of the `NotNull` flag when deriving functions' return type
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, when deriving a function's return type, TiDB does not care about the `NotNull` flag, an example is 
```
mysql> select v1 is null from test;
Field   1:  `v1 is null`
Catalog:    `def`
Database:   ``
Table:      ``
Org_table:  ``
Type:       LONGLONG
Collation:  binary (63)
Length:     1
Max_length: 0
Decimals:   0
Flags:      BINARY NUM


0 rows in set (0.02 sec)
```
As we can see, even for function `is null`, the return type in TiDB is nullable, and in MySQL, the return type is not null
```
mysql> select v1 is null from test;
Field   1:  `v1 is null`
Catalog:    `def`
Database:   ``
Table:      ``
Org_table:  ``
Type:       LONGLONG
Collation:  binary (63)
Length:     1
Max_length: 1
Decimals:   0
Flags:      NOT_NULL UNSIGNED BINARY NUM
```

This should be improved since if the input is not null, there will be some extra optimizations(especially in TiFlash)
